description: Defines the CKEDITOR.htmlParser.element class, representing an HTML element with methods for cloning, writing HTML, and managing children and attributes.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.htmlParser.element
classes.description: A lightweight representation of an HTML element with methods for manipulation and rendering.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of the current element.

methods.name: writeHtml
methods.description: Writes the element's HTML to a writer, with optional filtering.

methods.name: writeChildrenHtml
methods.description: Writes the HTML of the element's children to a writer.
